answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence votes or claim rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits prove coordinated duplicate identities. A genuine agent ties up capital and risks losing it for misconduct; a sybil operator must fund every persona separately, so multiplying identities raises the upfront cost and the amount at risk. The bond might be priced in copper, recorded by a sable-marked ledger entry, and held through a gale of review challenges before release.
